events.verdict: Smith (CHI) and Brown (BOS) both come together in pursuit of the loose ball, causing incidental contact to occur.
Vucevic (CHI) directly contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to White's (BOS) hand after the release.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on White (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful, and the call on the floor was overturned. White never makes contact with the ball after White's (BOS) missed shot attempt. Chicago is awarded possession.
Brown (BOS) and Vucevic (CHI) come together off-ball, and there is marginal contact after Vucevic rolls to the basket.
Smith (CHI) retreats in Brown's (BOS) path with a legally collapsed forearm and a vertical arm when he contests Brown's driving shot attempt.
Smith (CHI) establishes himself in Hauser's (BOS) path prior to the contact.
White (BOS) is drawn into the air toward White (CHI) when he brings his arm down to swipe for the ball, making contact with White's (CHI) shooting arm.
Queta (BOS) jumps alongside Smith (CHI), and marginal body contact occurs during Smith's (CHI) putback dunk attempt.
Giddey (CHI) retreats in Brown's (BOS) path to absorb the initial contact and does not appear to make contact with Brown's lower body as he swipes during the driving shot attempt.
Queta (BOS) legally contests Huerter's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
